artifacts.summary: Locates the missing exit-6 recovery hook in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's implemented) arm; surfaces the codebase's own already-documented D6 residual (regeneration-is-manual-only.md / batch-orchestration-guardrails.md) prescribing 'widen the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint predicate' over adding a third automated deploy-trigger site; flags cycle_modified_files accumulation as structurally unconditional on static reading (recommends a regression test to pin the exact live-run mechanism); documents the reconcile-task-status.sh replay-path gap for Part 3; confirms test coverage gaps in both named test files.

memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/core, the batch /orchestrate postflight completion-deploy gate (update-task-status.sh exit 6) already has its rc captured and annotated (deploy_pending:true in .return-meta.json) by skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh -- but orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's implemented) case arm discards that return value entirely (no || rc=$? capture), so the annotation is written but never acted on inside the batch loop. Any fix belongs at that call site, not by re-deriving the rc elsewhere.

context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md and batch-orchestration-guardrails.md already document a 'D6 residual': /orchestrate tasks refused by the postflight completion-deploy gate rely entirely on the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh Stage MT-3 step 7), and the docs explicitly prescribe widening that checkpoint's trigger predicate (currently keyed to the curated orchestrator-critical-paths.json allowlist, not full agent-system/extensions/** coverage) as the proper fix -- explicitly warning against adding a third automated deploy-headless.sh trigger site inside per-task postflight, since Move 2 dispatches run genuinely parallel and would race the fail-open specs/.deploy-lock mutex. Check these two docs before adding any new automated deploy trigger anywhere in this system.

After a successful scripts/orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh run, re-running orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh or /orchestrate directly opens a fresh dispatch window the existing .orchestrator-handoff.json predates, producing a false 'STALE HANDOFF' failure and a spurious HANDOFF_STALE_OR_ABSENT defect even when the underlying work was already complete. The correct replay path is reconcile-task-status.sh <task_number> <session_id>, which promotes a stuck in-flight status when the matching artifact (e.g. summaries/*.md) already exists on disk -- this was undocumented as of task 252's dispatch.
